extracted.intended_audience: Researchers (postdocs through senior researchers), prospective applicants to the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation sponsorship programmes
extracted.subtask_description: Information and selection/eligibility criteria for applying to the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation's fellowships, awards, and initiatives, aimed at researchers at different career stages seeking sponsorship for research in Germany and related programme activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellent performance is decisive
rubrics_metrics.description: "If you would like to become a member of the Humboldt Family, the only thing that counts is your own excellent performance."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection is based primarily on the applicant's demonstrated excellent academic performance; applicants should emphasize research achievements and excellence in their applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tailoring to individual career situation
rubrics_metrics.description: "We sponsor academic collaborations ... by granting research fellowships and awards, tailored to your own individual career situation."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should select programmes and frame proposals appropriate to their current career stage and needs — fellowships/awards are matched to individual career trajectories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programme fit via programme search
rubrics_metrics.description: "Use our programme search to find the sponsorship that fits your personal career"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are expected to identify the specific sponsorship opportunity that best fits their career stage and project; choosing the right programme is an implicit part of a successful application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Broad eligibility across career stages
rubrics_metrics.description: "Whether you are a postdoc at the beginning of your academic career or already a world authority in your discipline – we have the right programme for you."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmes target a range of career stages from early postdoctoral researchers to established world authorities; applicants should apply to the scheme appropriate to their status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open to all nationalities and research areas
rubrics_metrics.description: "The Humboldt Research Fellowship for researchers of all nationalities and research areas: We support you – postdoctoral and experienced researchers – with your research in Germany."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nationality and research-discipline restrictions are minimal for certain fellowships—candidates from any country and discipline may be eligible; applicants should check programme-specific eligibility details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection of "top" researchers for special initiatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Global Minds Initiative: "enables the Humboldt Foundation to offer additional fellowships and invite top researchers to Germany in the context of existing sponsorship opportunities."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some initiatives are explicitly targeted at inviting leading or 'top' researchers; competitiveness and demonstrated international standing may be emphasized for these calls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outstanding young researchers for Frontiers of Research Symposia
rubrics_metrics.description: "The Frontiers of Research symposia provide outstanding young researchers from the partner countries with a platform for the international and interdisciplinary exchange of knowledge."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection prioritizes 'outstanding' early-career researchers from partner countries and values international and interdisciplinary exchange; proposals or nominations should highlight excellence and interdisciplinary potential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Science–media dialogue target for Humboldt Communication Lab
rubrics_metrics.description: "A conversation between science and the media: twice a year, ten Humboldt Fellows and ten early-career journalists get together with the aim of learning from one another."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This programme selects a small cohort (ten fellows + ten journalists) and emphasizes mutual learning between researchers and media professionals; suitability for science communication engagement is a selection factor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transdisciplinary, impact-oriented projects for Residency Programme
rubrics_metrics.description: "This 'network within the network' aims to generate tangible new impetus in academia, society and politics. The programme reinforces innovation by transdisciplinary cooperation beyond the boundaries of science."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Residency proposals should demonstrate transdisciplinary approaches and potential societal/political impact; projects that bridge academia and broader societal domains are favored.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equal opportunities, family support and flexible structuring
rubrics_metrics.description: "Equal opportunities for researchers: Tapping academic potential – irrespective of gender; Balancing the demands of family and research; Family allowance for & flexible structuring"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation emphasizes equal-opportunity measures; applicants may expect provisions (e.g., family allowances, flexible structuring) and should indicate needs related to family responsibilities or diversity considerations where relevant.
